name: arize-phoenix
description: Connect Cursor to your Phoenix instance and the Phoenix docs. Ships the remote MCP server, the docs MCP, and skills for debugging traces, running evals, and instrumenting with OpenInference.

PHOENIX_ENDPOINT.title: Phoenix endpoint
PHOENIX_ENDPOINT.description: Base URL of your Phoenix instance, with no trailing slash (e.g. https://phoenix.example.com). The plugin appends /mcp. Same value as the PHOENIX_ENDPOINT environment variable the px CLI reads. Leave the default for a local Phoenix.
